description: The chart illustrates the relationship between perplexity and quantization bits for different datasets: WikiText, PTB, and C4. Each of the three sub-charts has quantization bits on the horizontal axis, labeled “Quantization Bits” with categories 3, 4, 8, and 16, arranged in ascending order. The vertical axis, labeled “Perplexity,” features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 for WikiText and C4, and 0 to 400 for PTB with tick labels shown at intervals of 5, 50 and 5, respectively. Within each sub-chart, paired bars represent two methods, “Uniform” (blue) and “Ours” (orange) for each quantization bit value. For WikiText, the “Uniform” bars range from approximately 22 to 28 in height, while the “Ours” bars are between approximately 17 and 23. In the PTB chart, “Uniform” bars range in height from approximately 170 to 390, and “Ours” bars range from approximately 170 to 230. The C4 chart shows “Uniform” bars ranging from approximately 21 to 29 and “Ours” bars ranging from approximately 16 to 22. The bars are arranged in pairs, grouped by quantization bit value, and are not visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation; no bars are shaded, bolded, outlined, or annotated.
